description_rewrite.new: Extreme ultraviolet (13.5nm) projection optics manufactured exclusively by Carl Zeiss SMT GmbH (industrial optics subsidiary of Zeiss Group). Each ASML EUV lithography system requires one set of precision-polished multilayer-coated optics with Ruthenium/Molybdenum coatings. Zeiss produces the most precise mirrors in the world using ion beam figuring to remove individual atomic-scale defects. Strategic partnership with ASML: ASML holds 24.9% equity stake and committed approximately €760 million over six years (post-2016) to support Zeiss SMT's R&D and capital expenditures for next-generation High-NA EUV optics development.
